items.heading: Shakshuka
details: Key ingredients: eggs, tomato, bell pepper, cumin, paprika
Saute onion and bell pepper until soft.
Add tomato, cumin and paprika, simmering into a thick sauce.
Crack eggs directly into wells in the sauce.
Cover and cook until the whites are set but yolks remain soft.

items.heading: Israeli Hummus
details: Key ingredients: chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic
Cook chickpeas until very soft.
Blend the chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice and garlic until smooth.
Adjust with cooking liquid until light and creamy.
Spread onto a plate, drizzle with olive oil and serve with warm pita.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
